requests.text: Alice joined Acme in London as research director on Monday. The team builds reliable search systems for hospitals, schools, and public agencies. During the first meeting, Alice reviewed the launch plan with Priya Shah and confirmed that Acme would open a new office in Manchester. Engineers discussed model quality, response speed, privacy controls, and multilingual support. The company expects the project to help nurses find patient records faster while keeping sensitive data protected. Alice will lead hiring, Priya will manage operations, and the research group will publish a progress report after the first customer trial next spring for British partners.
